name: Himekaribito
source:
France, end of 18th century. Provincial lord Gaston gets a request to investigate identities to three candidates to become wives of high official's son. In case some problem or disobedience is found, Gaston gets a Carte Blanche to use any means necessary.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
18世纪末的法国。地方领主加斯东受人委托，调查三名女子的身份。她们都是一位高官之子的妻子候选人。若发现任何问题或不服从的迹象，加斯东可全权采用一切必要手段。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
